recommended_thresholds.empty_region_fallback: If no DAB-positive regions are extracted, use nuclei p90 against T1/T2.

preprocessing.normalization: 95th-percentile white balance on bright background pixels, then DAB OD normalized by tissue DAB 99th percentile
preprocessing.stain_separation: rgb2hed color deconvolution, DAB channel used for brown stain strength
preprocessing.region_segmentation: DAB-positive region mask with threshold = max(DAB 70th percentile, Otsu threshold)

caveat: Thresholds are calibrated from 24 image-level labels rather than cell-level pathologist annotations, so they should be treated as preliminary and re-calibrated with more labeled cases.
